old_value: {"id":"mimid-1wgh.12.29","title":"Decision: v1 keeps read/mute/pin state per device","description":"Raised by crate-jmap-50 on JM-4 (.12.22): with Chat/set updates forbidden and no ReadPosition on the provider, a user's devices can't share read position, mute or pinned settings.
